title: Interface
summary: Blender's panels (viewport, outliner, properties, timeline), navigating with the mouse and the numpad views, and replacing the default cube: select it, X to delete, Shift+A to add a monkey (Suzanne).

objects.name: Suzanne
objects.description: the monkey, added to try the views

Shift+A > Mesh > Monkey; then 1, 3, 7 (and Ctrl) for front, side and top views
